title: Metrics events (JSONL, stdout)
description: The §13 'Planned metrics' surface: two JSONL event shapes `main::run_cycle`/`main::run` print to stdout, both distinct from the richer `decision` event covered by decision-event.schema.json. `metrics` is printed exactly once per account per cycle, regardless of success or failure, so a metrics consumer never has to correlate the success-only `decision` event with the failure-only `account_error` event just to count source/actuation success and failure. Multi-host accounts add a `hosts` array with per-host CPU/memory utilization when observed and placed worker counts. `cycle_metrics` is printed exactly once per full run_cycle invocation (not per account), carrying the loop-level timing and scheduling-drift metrics that have no per-account meaning. additionalProperties is left open everywhere because the underlying Rust metric structs in src/main.rs do not use #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)].

account.description: The configured account name (a `config.accounts` map key), matching the `decision` event's `decision.account`.

source_success.description: Whether the quota source (`source::collect`) returned a snapshot this cycle. False means every other field below `windows`/`actuation_attempted` is absent -- the cycle failed before a worker count or decision could be observed, and the corresponding detail is in a separate `account_error` event with `category: "observation"`.

sample_age_seconds.description: Present iff source_success. now - snapshot.observed_at at the moment this cycle observed it, clamped to zero the same way the controller's own staleness check is (a clock skew or future-dated sample is never reported as a negative age).

current_workers.description: Present iff the fleet worker observer succeeded this cycle (requires source_success, but may be present even when the controller's own evaluation subsequently failed).

desired_workers.description: Present iff a decision was computed this cycle. Echoes decision.desired_workers from the corresponding `decision` event.

decision_reason.description: Present iff a decision was computed. The account-level reason: the same derivation the status surface (readiness_for_decision, src/main.rs) uses -- "stale_data_holding" for a stale decision, "target_reached" for an intentional hold (including banked-reset manual-redemption holds), otherwise the binding window's own reason (or "healthy" if no window is binding).

binding_window.description: Present iff a decision was computed and a window won the §9.6 arbitration. Echoes decision.binding_window.

windows.description: One entry per observed, enabled window, in snapshot order. Empty when no decision was computed (source or worker-observer failure) or the decision was stale.

hosts.description: Present only when fleet.hosts is configured and placement completed. Each record is keyed by the parent account and host_id, with CPU and memory utilization when a resource snapshot was obtained and the placed target count.

actuation_attempted.description: True iff a decision was computed and the cycle was not observe-only -- i.e. the fleet actuator was invoked this cycle. False whenever no decision was reached, or the cycle ran with --observe-only.

actuation_succeeded.description: Present iff actuation_attempted. True when the actuator call returned Ok (whether or not it actually changed anything -- see the `decision` event's `actuated` field for that distinction). False when the actuator call itself failed, in which case a separate `account_error` event with `category: "actuation"` carries the error detail.

id.description: Echoes the corresponding windowDecision.id from the `decision` event.

seconds_until_reset.description: window.resets_at - decision time, clamped to zero -- a reset the clock has passed but the provider has not yet rolled over (§9.3 "reset_due") is reported as zero seconds away, never negative.

placed_workers.description: The target count assigned to this host by placement, whether or not this cycle was observe-only.

cycleMetrics.description: Printed once per run_cycle invocation (main::run), immediately after that cycle's per-account decision/metrics/account_error events. Absent in a process that never reaches the run loop (check/snapshot commands emit no JSONL events at all).

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent inside this cycle's run_cycle call (iterating every account), not including the inter-cycle sleep.

late.description: True when this cycle's actual start lagged its scheduled anchor by more than the maximum jitter `bounded_jitter` could have added for the configured poll_interval_seconds -- i.e. delayed by something other than the deliberate startup jitter, typically the previous cycle overrunning its interval. Always false for the first cycle of a run, which has no schedule to be late against.

skipped_cycles.description: Whole additional poll intervals that elapsed on top of `late`'s drift before this cycle started (0 in the ordinary case). Non-zero only after a cycle overran the interval badly enough that one or more entire scheduled slots were skipped rather than merely delayed.

accounts_total.description: config.accounts.len() at the start of this cycle -- the number of accounts this cycle attempted to process (fewer may have actually been reached if shutdown was requested mid-cycle).

observation_failures.description: Echoes CycleOutcome.observation_failures: accounts whose source, worker observer, or controller evaluation failed this cycle.

actuation_failures.description: Echoes CycleOutcome.actuation_failures: accounts whose fleet actuator call failed this cycle.
